title: predict.final
description: Phase 5.2: calibrated swarm consensus. Control-plane topic — unversioned by design (ROADMAP §3.7); the proofreader-approved data-plane mirror is `predict.approved.v1`. Single-publication per `(match_id, market, request_id)`. `degraded=true` + `degraded_reason` when fewer than `cfg.consensus_min_voters` predictors voted (Phase 12 contract). `prediction_id` is sha256(match_id|market|request_id|calibration_version)[:32]. Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::PredictFinal`.

distribution.description: {market_outcomes: dict[outcome -> prob], score_grid?: list[list[float]] | null}. When present, score_grid is a square 2D matrix where score_grid[home][away] = P(home goals = h, away goals = a); element-wise mean of contributing votes' grids.
